name: IC Memory — 5V, SPI, 2.5V — SOIC
description: Surface-mount memory IC cluster featuring SPI Flash and EEPROM devices in SOIC-8 (3.9x4.9mm, 1.27mm pitch) footprints with 2.5V and 5V support.
selection_hints: Select when requiring SMD SPI memory ICs (Flash or EEPROM) in a SOIC-8 footprint.
Choose for designs operating with 2.5V or 5V supply levels.
Verify matching with the SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm footprint.
avoid_when: Do not use if through-hole or non-SOIC packaging is required.
Avoid if an interface other than SPI is needed.
Avoid when non-memory ICs or unsupported voltage levels are required.
